gene_col.description: Gene id column in the rank / log2FC table. Auto-detected when empty.

stat_col.description: Ranking statistic column (log2FC). Auto-detected when empty.

term_col.description: Pathway/term column in the GSEA table. Auto-detected when empty.

pvalue_col.description: Raw p-value column. Auto-detected when empty.

fdr_col.description: Adjusted p-value / FDR column. Auto-detected when empty.

selected_terms.description: Pathway names to plot. Empty uses top_n_terms.

top_n_terms.description: Number of pathways when selected_terms is omitted.

gene_scope.description: Use full gene-set members or leading-edge genes for the ridge.

min_genes.description: Drop pathways with fewer matched genes than this.

min_match_fraction.description: Optional minimum fraction of pathway genes matched to the rank table.

duplicate_gene_action.description: How to collapse duplicate gene ids in the rank table.

genesets_file.description: Optional GMT path when --genesets is not passed.

order_by.description: Y-axis order. NES is descending (positive enrichment at the top).

pathway_order.description: Explicit order when order_by is custom.

significance_source.description: Which p-value maps to ridge fill.

xlim.description: Optional [min, max] for log2FC. Empty uses the data range.

xlim_quantile.description: Trim this quantile from each tail when xlim is empty.
